question: The Golden Quadrilateral that connects the four major cities of Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata is part of the _________ project.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatmala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Golden Quadrilateral that connects the four major cities of Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata is part of the Bharatmala project.**
 
• The principal routes of the Indian Railways on the** Golden Quadrilateral and diagonals are:**
 
 
• **Delhi - Mumbai, Delhi - Howrah, Howrah - Chennai, Chennai - Mumbai, Delhi - Chennai, and Howrah - Mumbai)**
 
 
 
• ​Carrying about 58% of freight traffic and 52% of coaching
